notes:
{花|はな} is a fundamental nature word referring to flowers and blossoms. In Japanese culture, flowers hold deep significance.

PRONUNCIATION:
- はな: standalone and many compounds
- か: in some compounds like ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧ (vase)
- ばな: after certain words like ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧ (flower arrangement)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {花|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: flowers bloom
- {花|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}ける→生ける：10667_ikeru⟧: to arrange flowers
- {花|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to give flowers
- ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧: flower viewing (especially cherry blossoms)
- ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧: fireworks

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ is a beloved spring tradition of viewing cherry blossoms. {花|はな} alone often implies ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossoms) in spring contexts.
